data.text: Flaky on CI: perf.test.ts 'cold loadState reads the journal once, not twice' failed on PR #14, Node 20 only — loadState 130 ms against loadOrBuild 76 ms, ratio 1.71 over the 1.6 margin — with no change to loadState, loadOrBuild or the snapshot since #13, where it passed on the same runner image. Locally 231 against 243 (0.95). Two cold measurements taken one after the other on a shared runner; the second paid for something the first did not. Re-run requested rather than widening the margin.
